interactions.label: weather x status
interactions.mechanism: Sun prevents a new freeze; weather itself is not a major-status cure. `seteffect` checks sun before Ice type/Magma Armor (`battle_script_commands.c:2380-2393`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptHitChainOpcode.test.ts` (freeze applies without weather and is blocked by active sun)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R1 receipts the RNG-gated Ice Beam pair on two freeze-producing seeds.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: weather x volatile
interactions.mechanism: Sand/hail chip skips underground and underwater; weather also changes Thunder's accuracy while semi-invulnerability is checked first (`battle_script_commands.c:1062-1094`, `7602-7640`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptDamagingWeatherOpcode.test.ts` (underground weather chip); `tests/gate6WeatherVolatileInteractions.test.ts` (R2 full weather pass, damage/message order); `tests/gate6R2Receipt.test.ts` (compact OFF receipt)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R2 complete: Dig under Hail, then surface, paired with a grounded two-turn control.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: weather x held-item
interactions.mechanism: The only shared scheduling boundary is end-turn: abilities, normal items, then Leech Seed/poison are sequenced by `DoBattlerEndTurnEffects` (`battle_util.c:1494-1533`); weather damage is a separate script loop (`battle_scripts_1.s:3200-3222`). No weather-specific held-item branch exists.
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/gate6KernelInteractions.test.ts` (K1: sand chip precedes Leftovers/Sitrus activation, exact HP event sequences, Sitrus threshold crossing, no-weather controls)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: K1 complete (kernel proof; event order matched source, no oracle promotion needed).
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: weather x ability
interactions.mechanism: Cloud Nine/Air Lock suppress **all** `WEATHER_HAS_EFFECT`; Forecast changes Castform's type in rain/sun/hail; Rain Dish, Swift Swim and Chlorophyll read active weather; Sand Veil changes accuracy (`battle_util.h:47-48`; `battle_util.c:2396-2427,2955-2970`; `battle_script_commands.c:1152-1155`). Air Lock is UNREACHABLE; Cloud Nine/Forecast and the speed/end-turn abilities are legal.
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptDamagingWeatherOpcode.test.ts` (Cloud Nine, Sand Veil); `tests/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.test.ts` (weather entry scheduling); `tests/gate6WeatherAbilityInteractions.test.ts` (R4 Forecast form/type pairs, Weather Ball type/power under every weather, exact two-seed damage); `tests/gate6R3Receipt.test.ts` (legal removal/reactivation receipt)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R4 and R3 complete: same-turn Forecast/Weather Ball behavior is paired with the legal Golduck Cloud Nine → neutral Rattata switch; Castform stays Normal while Cloud Nine is present, then becomes Water and uses Weather Ball after the switch.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: weather x stat-stage
interactions.mechanism: Accuracy calculation applies accuracy/evasion stages before sun-Thunder and Sand Veil modifiers (`battle_script_commands.c:1128-1155`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/gate6KernelInteractions.test.ts` (K2: sun/rain/sand across stages -2/0/+2; sun boundaries 30/50/83, Sand Veil 33/56/92, rain Thunder zero-RNG guaranteed hit)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: K2 complete — and it caught a real kernel defect: `battleScriptHitChainOpcode.ts` hardcoded weather inactive in accuracy checks (rain-Thunder bypass, sun-Thunder 50, Sand Veil all missing); fixed source-cited in `450cf532`.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: weather x switching/entry
interactions.mechanism: Entry weather abilities set permanent weather exactly on switch-in; subsequent same-weather entries are a no-op (`battle_util.c:2485-2558`). Drizzle/Sand Stream/Drought are **UNREACHABLE (3)** at L50; Cloud Nine is a legal entry suppression case.
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.test.ts` (Drizzle/Sand Stream/Drought unit mechanics); `tests/gate6R3Receipt.test.ts` (ordinary party-menu switch and preserved weather timer)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R3 complete: Rain Dance sets the real field flag/timer, the player switch replaces Cloud Nine with neutral Rattata without clearing rain, and the post-switch Forecast/Weather Ball consumer sees active rain.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: weather x immunity/absorb
interactions.mechanism: Type immunity (Rock/Ground/Steel vs sand, Ice vs hail), Sand Veil, and underground/underwater suppress weather chip (`battle_script_commands.c:7606-7640`); Cloud Nine globally suppresses the predicate (`battle_util.h:47-48`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptDamagingWeatherOpcode.test.ts`; `tests/gate6WeatherVolatileInteractions.test.ts` (R2); `tests/gate6R2Receipt.test.ts` (R2 compact receipt); `tests/gate6R3Receipt.test.ts` (Cloud Nine suppression/removal boundary)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R2/R3 complete: R2 receipts the concrete hail immunity/underground gate, while R3 receipts the global Cloud Nine suppression and its reactivation after switching.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: status x volatile
interactions.mechanism: Sleep clears Nightmare when cured; confusion, paralysis, and infatuation are independent ordered attack-canceler gates (`battle_util.c:2040-2054,2156-2218`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/gate6KernelInteractions.test.ts` (K3: Chesto/Lum clear sleep+Nightmare, preserve unrelated infatuation; confusion → paralysis → infatuation gate order; resumable RNG ledger with skipped draws pinned on early-outs)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: K3 complete (kernel proof).
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: status x held-item
interactions.mechanism: Chesto clears sleep and Nightmare; condition berries cure their matching major status; Lum clears any major status plus confusion (`battle_util.c:3499-3591`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptMoveEndOpcode.test.ts` (Cheri/Lum move-end activation); `tests/gate6EntryItemInteractions.test.ts` (R5 Chesto sleep+Nightmare and Lum confusion specificity)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R5 receipts exact Chesto/Lum controller timing.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: status x ability
interactions.mechanism: Natural Cure clears major status on switch-out; Guts/Marvel Scale read status for stats; immunities reject sleep/poison/burn/freeze/paralysis and Own Tempo rejects confusion (`battle_script_commands.c:9590-9604,2360-2435,2531-2545`; `battle_util.c:2873-2945`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptMoveEndOpcode.test.ts` (ability status cures/Own Tempo); `tests/gate6StatusAbilityInteractions.test.ts` (R7 complete burn/Guts/Facade scripts, arithmetic, and chip)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R6 complete; R7 complete with two-seed OFF-ROM receipts.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: status x stat-stage
interactions.mechanism: Burn's physical Attack modifier and paralysis speed modifier belong in stat calculation, while status application does not itself mutate stages; stage mutation is separately clamped (`battle_script_commands.c:7085-7089`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/gate6KernelInteractions.test.ts` (K4: burn Attack-halving and paralysis speed-quartering live in stat/damage calc with fixed stages; status application never mutates stages; burn + +2 Attack combined case in source order)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: K4 complete (kernel proof, `8b63e15e`).
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: status x switching/entry
interactions.mechanism: Ordinary switching rebuilds the incoming record; Natural Cure only clears the departing major status (`battle_script_commands.c:4621-4657,9590-9604`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.test.ts` (rebuild semantics)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R6 oracle.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: status x immunity/absorb
interactions.mechanism: Type/ability gates prevent status before durable mutation: Fire blocks burn, Ice blocks freeze, Limber blocks paralysis, Immunity blocks poison (`battle_script_commands.c:2360-2425`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptMoveEndOpcode.test.ts` (immunity cure pass); `tests/gate6StatusImmunityInteractions.test.ts` (R8 complete primary-effect scripts and ordinary controls)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R8 complete with paired two-seed OFF-ROM receipts.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: volatile x held-item
interactions.mechanism: Persim/Lum cure confusion; Mental Herb cures attraction; White Herb restores negative stages, including at move-end (`battle_util.c:3383-3398,3540-3601,3739-3755`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptMoveEndOpcode.test.ts` (Lum confusion); `tests/gate6R9Receipt.test.ts` (legal Swagger/Lum versus White Herb receipt)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R9 complete: Lum cures confusion then consumes itself without undoing Swagger's +2 Attack, while White Herb has no negative stage to restore and remains held through confusion.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: volatile x ability
interactions.mechanism: Own Tempo blocks confusion, Oblivious blocks attraction, Soundproof blocks sound-based state effects; end-turn ability hooks run before item hooks (`battle_script_commands.c:2531-2545,7676-7695,8508-8533`; `battle_util.c:1494-1507`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptTryinfatuatingOpcode.test.ts`; `tests/battleScriptTrysetperishsongOpcode.test.ts`; `tests/gate6VolatileAbilityInteractions.test.ts`
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R10 complete: paired Attract/Oblivious receipt plus Soundproof partial-immunity receipt.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: volatile x stat-stage
interactions.mechanism: Swagger/Flatter-like effects combine a volatile application with a stat change; accuracy/evasion stages combine with Foresight's volatile exception (`battle_script_commands.c:1128-1142`; stat application `7085-7089`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/gate6KernelInteractions.test.ts` (K5: Swagger emits exactly one 6→8 Attack change + confusion; Own Tempo still receives +2 before rejecting confusion; Foresight ignores target evasion only, attacker accuracy stays active; `battle_scripts_1.s:1608-1629`)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: K5 complete (kernel proof, `f368de69`).
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: volatile x switching/entry
interactions.mechanism: Ordinary switch replaces state; Baton Pass preserves `status2` and all stat stages, then clear-set-data handles the remainder (`battle_script_commands.c:4621-4657`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.test.ts` (ordinary clear/Baton Pass retain)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R11 oracle: Substitute/Focus Energy/Baton Pass versus ordinary switch.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: volatile x immunity/absorb
interactions.mechanism: Semi-invulnerable state blocks ordinary targeting; it also suppresses weather chip only underground/underwater (`battle_script_commands.c:1062-1085,7606-7635`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptDamagingWeatherOpcode.test.ts`; `tests/gate6R2Receipt.test.ts`
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R2 compact OFF receipt (shared with weather).
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: held-item x ability
interactions.mechanism: Entry/fainted-action orchestration invokes Intimidate/Trace before normal item effects, so an Intimidate-created negative stage can feed White Herb (`battle_util.c:1959-1964,3305-3329`). Pinsir cannot demonstrate that interaction: its sole legal ability is Hyper Cutter, which prevents Intimidate's Attack drop before the item can activate (`species_info.h:3819-3843`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.test.ts` (Intimidate/Trace); `tests/battleScriptMoveEndOpcode.test.ts` (item effects)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R12 is the Pinsir prevention control; R12b uses legal White Herb Machamp (Guts) for the activation/order/consumption proof.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: held-item x stat-stage
interactions.mechanism: White Herb restores every negative stage, and threshold berries raise a stage only below the cap (`battle_util.c:3383-3398,3431-3496`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptMoveEndOpcode.test.ts` (item activation); `tests/gate6KernelInteractions.test.ts` (K6: Liechi/Salac/Petaya parameterized across stages 0/5/6/10/11/12 — activation only below the +6 cap; White Herb restores all negative stages exactly once and stays held when nothing is restorable; Ganlon/Apicot stay excluded as zero-carrier); `tests/gate6R9Receipt.test.ts` (positive-stage guard)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: K6/R9/R12b complete: R9's +2 Swagger result proves that White Herb stays held when no negative stage exists.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: held-item x switching/entry
interactions.mechanism: White Herb has an explicit switch-in handler that normalizes negative stages (`battle_util.c:3305-3329`); a normal switch reconstructs the party item unless Knock Off recorded it (`battle_script_commands.c:4637-4646`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.test.ts` (item reconstruction); `tests/gate6R12Receipt.test.ts`
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R12 complete: Hyper Cutter prevents Granbull's entry drop before White Herb has a negative stage to restore, so both battle and party item copies remain held.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: held-item x immunity/absorb
interactions.mechanism: No held-item branch changes an ability/type absorb result in Gen III; item effects run only after damage/effect eligibility.  Absorb handler is ability-only (`battle_util.c:2676-2747`) and item dispatch is separate (`3257-3330`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/gate6EntryItemInteractions.test.ts` (K7: all three matching redirects preserve Sitrus before damage/item dispatch)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: Closed by K7; no new ROM fixture needed.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: ability x stat-stage
interactions.mechanism: Clear Body/White Smoke block most preventable drops; Keen Eye blocks accuracy and Hyper Cutter Attack specifically; Intimidate creates an Attack drop (`battle_script_commands.c:6975-7038`; `battle_util.c:3003-3087`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptStatbuffchangeOpcode.test.ts` (Clear Body/White Smoke/Keen Eye/Hyper Cutter specificity); `tests/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.test.ts` (Intimidate blockers); `tests/gate6EntryItemInteractions.test.ts` (R13 Pidgeot pair)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R13 fixture receipts the paired Keen Eye-specific block and unrelated Intimidate Attack drop.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: ability x switching/entry
interactions.mechanism: Switch-in scan queues weather, Intimidate, Trace, and Forecast; Natural Cure is the distinct switch-out hook (`battle_util.c:1959-1964,2485-2596`; `battle_script_commands.c:9590-9604`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.test.ts`
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R6/R12/R13 cover legal ordered combinations.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: ability x immunity/absorb
interactions.mechanism: Volt/Water Absorb and Flash Fire use the absorbing handler; Levitate, Wonder Guard, Soundproof and status immunities gate effects elsewhere (`battle_util.c:2676-2747`; `battle_script_commands.c:1375-1496,2275-2425`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptHitChainOpcode.test.ts` (all three matching/mismatched types, full/partial HP, Flash Fire state); `tests/damageCalc.test.ts` (Flash Fire damage consumer); `tests/battleScriptMoveEndOpcode.test.ts` (status immunity); `tests/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.test.ts` (Levitate entry); `tests/battleScriptTrysetperishsongOpcode.test.ts` (Soundproof)
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R14 already covered; Volt Absorb additionally has two-seed OFF-ROM receipts. R10 Soundproof is now independently receipted.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: stat-stage x switching/entry
interactions.mechanism: Normal switch discards stages because full incoming BattlePokemon overwrites the active record; Baton Pass copies all stages first (`battle_script_commands.c:4621-4657`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.test.ts`
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R11 oracle.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: stat-stage x immunity/absorb
interactions.mechanism: The stat-drop immunity family is the boundary: Clear Body/White Smoke/Keen Eye/Hyper Cutter and Shield Dust suppress eligible drops (`battle_script_commands.c:6975-7038`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptStatbuffchangeOpcode.test.ts`
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R13 oracle.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.

interactions.label: switching/entry x immunity/absorb
interactions.mechanism: Spikes damages only a non-Flying, non-Levitate switch-in (`battle_script_commands.c:5219-5254`); switch-in also obtains the incoming ability from species/slot (`4637-4646`).
interactions.existingTier1Coverage: `tests/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.test.ts`
interactions.gapOrFirstProof: R15 complete: three layers, real Flying/Levitate entries, and a grounded three-layer control.
interactions.notes: Pairwise evidence is not a Cartesian-product claim.
